decks.notes: The main concept of this UR Tempo deck is to efficiently control the tempo of the game by quickly deploying threats like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler while disrupting the opponent with counterspells like Daze and Force of Will. The deck aims to maintain card advantage with cantrips like Ponder and Brainstorm, while also applying pressure with burn spells like Lightning Bolt. Mishra's Bauble and Flow State enhance the deck's card selection and prowess mechanic, making it a powerful aggro deck capable of quickly closing out games. The mana base is optimized to support the deck's tempo strategy with efficient land choices.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly get powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty into the graveyard, then reanimate them to overwhelm the opponent. This is achieved through a combination of discard spells like Thoughtseize and Faithless Looting, along with reanimation spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The deck also includes ramp cards like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal to cast big creatures ahead of schedule. Overall, the strategy revolves around cheating big threats into play early and exploiting their powerful abilities to win the game.

The deck focuses on using artifacts to control the board and disrupt opponents while setting up a powerful win condition. By utilizing cards like Trinisphere and Chalice of the Void, the deck aims to slow down opponents while building up resources with cards like Mystic Forge and Grim Monolith. The One Ring and Urza's Saga provide powerful late-game threats, while cards like Voltaic Key and Manifold Key can untap artifacts for additional value. Overall, the deck aims to lock down the game and overwhelm opponents with powerful artifact-based strategies.

The main concept of this UR Tempo deck is to aggressively disrupt the opponent's resources and game plan while applying pressure with efficient and evasive creatures. It focuses on tempo plays like countering spells with Force of Will and Daze, alongside disruption from Wasteland and efficient burn spells like Lightning Bolt. The deck also utilizes card selection with cantrips like Ponder and Brainstorm to ensure consistent draws. Overall, the goal is to disrupt the opponent's strategy while quickly closing out the game with evasive threats like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler.

This deck focuses on utilizing fast mana sources and cards that generate card advantage to assemble a game-winning storm combo. By quickly ramping into mana with Dark Ritual, Lion's Eye Diamond, and Mox Opal, the deck aims to cast spells like Burning Wish and Tendrils of Agony to deal a large amount of damage in one turn. The inclusion of cards like Echo of Eons and Song of Creation helps to refill the player's hand and generate additional resources to ensure the combo goes off successfully. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Hexing Squelcher to protect the combo.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble the Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage combo in order to create a 20/20 Marit Lage token, which can quickly close out the game. The deck includes cards like Crop Rotation and Green Sun's Zenith to help find the combo pieces, while also including interaction like Swords to Plowshares and Mox Diamond for support. The deck aims to ramp up quickly and disrupt the opponent's game plan while working towards assembling the combo for a powerful finish.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan through a combination of hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize, counterspells like Force of Will, and removal spells like Fatal Push and Snuff Out. It aims to maintain tempo by deploying threats like Murktide Regent and Nethergoyf while controlling the board with cards like Daze and Wasteland. The deck also utilizes cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder to smooth out draws and ensure consistency. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure while keeping the opponent off balance and controlling the pace of the game.

The main concept of this combo deck is to quickly assemble all the necessary pieces to generate a large amount of mana and cast powerful spells. It utilizes cards like Dark Ritual, Lotus Petal, and Mishra's Bauble to ramp up mana, while also including disruption like Force of Will and Thoughtseize to protect its combo pieces. The deck also features ways to dig through the library for key cards with Brainstorm and Ponder. The win condition is to utilize The Fantasticar in combination with Flow State and Stormchaser's Talent to deal lethal damage to the opponent.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy centered around powerful human creatures. By utilizing cards like Basim Ibn Ishaq and Esper Sentinel, the deck can control the board while quickly building up a strong attacking force. Additionally, support cards like Force of Will and Force of Negation provide protection against opposing threats. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive strategy with lands like Gaea's Cradle and Cavern of Souls. Overall, the key idea is to put pressure on the opponent early and maintain control throughout the game.

This deck focuses on using Mystic Forge in combination with cards like Grim Monolith and Manifold Key to quickly assemble powerful combos and generate massive advantage. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Chalice of the Void to control the opponent's game plan. With a mix of mana acceleration, card draw, and powerful artifacts, this deck is designed to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of powerful plays.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize a combination of artifact creatures and non-creature artifacts to create a synergistic aggro strategy. By utilizing cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Urza's Saga, the deck aims to quickly establish a board presence and overwhelm the opponent with efficient threats. Additionally, cards like Mishra's Bauble and Grim Monolith provide card advantage and ramping capabilities to further support the aggressive game plan. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will to protect its creatures and disrupt opponents' strategies.

The main focus of this UWx Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan through countermagic, removal spells, and land destruction. The deck aims to control the game by utilizing cards like Force of Will, Swords to Plowshares, and Wasteland to shut down threats. Teferi, Time Raveler and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provide additional control elements, while Quantum Riddler and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd give the deck card advantage and protection. The deck also includes cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder for card selection and consistency in drawing answers.

The deck is focused on utilizing efficient creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Merfolk cards like Cori-Steel Cutter to apply pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze. The deck also includes powerful removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to deal with opposing threats. Additionally, the deck features cantrips like Ponder and Brainstorm to find key cards and maintain card advantage. The aim is to tempo out opponents by efficiently controlling the board while applying pressure to win the game quickly.

This UR Tempo deck focuses on quickly deploying threats and disrupting the opponent's strategy with counterspells and removal. The key concept is to maintain a balance between aggression and control, using cards like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Mishra's Bauble to generate card advantage while applying pressure. By efficiently utilizing cards like Lightning Bolt and Daze, the deck aims to keep the opponent on the back foot while maintaining a clock with powerful threats like Murktide Regent. The deck's versatility and synergy between its components allow for adaptable and dynamic gameplay.

This combo deck aims to quickly assemble and cast Doomsday, which allows the player to stack the top 5 cards of their library in any order. By stacking the deck with specific cards like Thassa's Oracle and Lion's Eye Diamond, the player can win the game on the same turn. The deck includes various cantrips and counterspells to dig for combo pieces and protect the combo. The key to success lies in efficiently executing the Doomsday combo while managing the resources and protecting the combo from disruption.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by using a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive abilities. The deck includes powerful cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to help maintain control over the board. Cards like Stifle and Wasteland are included to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while Quantum Riddler and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd provide card advantage and long-term value. The deck aims to outlast the opponent and win through incremental advantage and disruption.
